title: Foundational Digital Capabilities Research (FDCR) platform
summary: A 10-year research programme established by the Department of Science and Innovation and implemented by the CSIR to build foundational digital capabilities for use across economic sectors, in line with the Digital Economy Masterplan. Artificial intelligence, robotics and cybernetics is the first of five research domains; the others are cloud-to-edge computing and IoT, extended reality, blockchain and cybersecurity, and modelling and simulation. The CSIR told Parliament in October 2024 that the plan averages about R100 million a year, excluding infrastructure, and that a 16% budget cut had affected timelines. The FDCR2025 conference was held in July 2025.
beneficiaries: CSIR researchers, postgraduate students and industry partners
